reviews.text:
From start to finish an easy, accommodating process. Dustin that got us scheduled walked us through the insurance paperwork & gave detailed explanations of what they were paying for and how well the home was inspected.
Jay that was the project manager chose good times of the day to communicate with us about the project. Received drone aerial shots of the progress & completion. Super cool to see. They showed up when they said they would and were done before we got home. No nails, no mess and the roof looks amazing. So glad we chose Circle L for the job! 10/10 would recommend!
reviews.author: Chief

reviews.text:
Excellent work and service!!!

By far Jose Carrillo is the best roofer I have worked with, and highly recommended without hesitation ! They replaced the roof after a hail storm. Jose was thorough on what and how the work would be done, and was there to ensure the work and quality were met.

They left the house, clean of debris, honest and trustworthy delivered the highest of qualities !
reviews.author: Lizeth Castillo

reviews.text: Just had our roof replaced thanks to Jose Castillo and I couldn't be happier.  He was wonderful with going over all the paperwork, working with us on time frames, and making the whole process go as smooth as possible. The crew came out and did the whole tear down and install in 3 hours!!! It was amazing and they did a beautiful job! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!
reviews.author: Summer Hogan

reviews.text:
Jose was very prompt and professional in responding to my concerns regarding my home. He took the time to fully listen to what was going on, and after investigating and inspecting it, he found the root of the leak and guided me in filing my insurance claim.

He came out and attended the insurance adjuster meeting to help allocate for all the damage items to be included in the estimate. Less than six weeks later I had this beautiful roof installed.

Jose will forever be my go to roofing expert. Will be recommending him to friends and family for sure!
reviews.author: Henry Hernandez

reviews.text: José Carillo is the best! Strives to give you peace of mind over your home. He is honest and doesn’t just try to get the sale on a new roof if it isn’t necessary. Was in the process of buying a house and had a few shingles damaged from a nearby tree. He recommended repairing/replacing where the damage was since the roof overall still had years of life. Will forever recommend Jose to all of our homeowner friends. Quality and honest work!
reviews.author: Leticia Velázquez

reviews.text: We bought a 1980s home and we knew that soon the roof will needed to be replace. A couple hail storms happened after owning the house for a few months, created a leak and a small electrical fire. That’s the worse news anyone want to hear after purchasing a home. Jose Carrillo help me out, guided me through the process to make sure I fully understood what his company was doing. I felt confident in his work. He made some upgrades that’s I’m forever grateful for. Today I came home to a new roof and I inspected everything. SUCH CLEAN & PROFESSIONAL WORK! I’m referring all of my homeowner friends but I’m so happy with the outcome. I would use them and trust them for any work needed done at my home. 1000/10 recommend
reviews.author: Painted Hair Society

reviews.text: Jose Carrillo offered to look at our roof after the latest storm in our area. Gave our family piece of mind of the condition our roof was in. He was very informative and helpful would definitely recommend him and this company to our family and neighbors.
reviews.author: Juanita and Alejandro Rivera (Familia Rivera)

reviews.text: Circle L Roofing was fantastic to work with. More specifically, Shaun. His attention to detail, knowledge and honesty set him above the rest. He was on site daily and was always available to answer any questions I had. The crew was efficient and completed my project in time for the most recent wind/rain storm that just hit DFW.  This including reinstalling my 32 panel solar panels (also provided by Circle L solar). The finished product is sleek, attractive and oh BTW provides a 25% discount on my homeowners insurance.  Thank you, Shaun for suggesting the Class 4 roof! Your guidance through this process made it enjoyable. How many can say that about a new roof install? Highly recommend Circle L not only for your roofing needs, but if you're thinking solar...give them a call! Best customer service out there!
reviews.author: Dannelle Mielbrecht

data.summary: Reviews appear mostly authentic with some minor red flags. The company has perfect Google ratings (5.0 with 40+ reviews) and BBB A rating. Reviews contain specific details about insurance processes, project management, and outcomes. However, the repeated mention of the same employee (Jose) in multiple reviews and lack of any negative feedback raises mild suspicion.

All sampled reviews are 5-star with similar positive tone
authentic_signals: Specific project details (insurance paperwork, hail damage, solar panels)
